DATA/LABEL FINDING for whoever ships it: the positively worded items CESD05 ('promising situations') and CESD08 ('happy situations') are stored ALREADY REVERSED relative to their own value labels -- they correlate +0.07..+0.24 with every negative item and +0.57 with each other, and the Depression total equals the raw sum (100%) while reversing 5 and 8 reproduces it for only 15.7% of rows. The banked candidate therefore attaches the value labels to CESD05/CESD08 in reverse (resp 0 = 'most or all of the time (5-7 days)'), the baka2023_bpnsf override shape. Second, CESD02's label ('how often do I feel like dying or hurting myself in some way?') is NOT canonical CES-D-10 item 2 (Andresen 1994: 'I had trouble keeping my mind on what I was doing'); the data back the label: CESD02 is the least-endorsed item (mean 0.250, 80.5% at 0, vs 0.41-1.15 for the rest), the marker-item signature of a self-harm item.
